name: Oats Muesli Fruit & Nut
ingredients: Multigrain (55%) (Rolled Oat 26%, Rice & Rice Flour 14%, Corn Grit & Flour 7%, Rolled Barley 5%, Wheat 3%, Refined Wheat Flour (Maida) 1.4%), Candied & Dry Fruit and Nut & Seed (22%) (Raisin 10%, Candied Papaya 5%, Almond 4%, Pumpkin Seed 3%), Sugar, Palmolein Oil, Maltodextrin, Invert Syrup, Stabiliser (1422, 170i, 322), Liquid Glucose, lodised Salt, Cereal Extract. Flavour (Natural and Nature Identical Flavouring Substances), Colour (150d), Antioxidant (307b).
